commitResults.messageBody:
main() mixed high-level steps (calling parse helpers) with low-level
details (string splitting, for-loops, printlns), so commands such as
"list" and "mark" sat at very different levels of abstraction.

- main() is now four steps: welcome, load, run command loop, save.
- executeCommand() dispatches each command word to one handler call.
- Merge the duplicated getTaskByNumber/deleteTaskByNumber validation
  into parseTaskIndex(), shared by mark, unmark and delete.
- Share one addTask() for todo, deadline and event.
- Extract output into print* helpers and task (de)serialisation into
  encodeTask/decodeTask so load/save only deal with file I/O.
- Group methods into sections: command loop, handlers, parsing, UI,
  storage.
- Remove trivial comments.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Storage class for loading and saving tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Moves file I/O and the save-file format out of Shaheer so each class
has one responsibility. Storage throws ShaheerException on I/O errors
instead of printing; Shaheer reports them. Behaviour is unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Ui class for user interaction
commitResults.messageBody:
Moves all console input/output out of Shaheer into Ui. Shaheer is now
instance-based (ui, storage, tasks fields, run()) so handlers can share
one Ui. Tasks load in the constructor, so a load error now prints
before the welcome banner.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract TaskList class to manage the task list
commitResults.messageBody:
Wraps List<Task> with add/get/delete/size. The task-number range check
moves from parseTaskIndex into TaskList, since it is about the list,
not parsing. Behaviour is unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Parser class for interpreting user input
commitResults.messageBody:
Moves command-word/argument splitting and task-number, todo, deadline
and event parsing out of Shaheer. Shaheer now only coordinates Ui,
Storage, TaskList and Parser. Behaviour is unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Command classes for each user action
commitResults.messageBody:
Each action is now a Command subclass with execute() and isExit(),
replacing Shaheer's handler methods. Shaheer still chooses which
Command to create; that moves to Parser next. Behaviour is unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge A-MoreOOP: extract Ui, Storage, Parser, TaskList and Command classes
Add find command to search tasks by keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
"find <keyword>" lists tasks whose description contains the keyword,
ignoring case. A blank keyword is rejected with a usage hint.
